category_title: Youth with intellectual disabilities who thrive in hands-on retail environments
minimal_context: Eric is sitting in the classroom completing paperwork to prepare for an upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Eric, please sit down and start working on this paperwork to prepare for the upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do this. I like hands-on learning, not just sitting here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just focus on the worksheet in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But school is just a place where we sit down and just do paperwork. It doesn't teach me any skills.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to know this information for the exam. Keep reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away) No. I'm just going to learn this for your test and then forget about it. I want to do something real, like prepare for an interview.

task.content: Completing traditional school paperwork and learning for a test

context.environment: Traditional special education classes and intensive three-week classroom component
context.materials: Paperwork, tests, materials to make a résumé and cover letter, interview preparation resources

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When required to sit down and complete traditional school paperwork and test preparation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Depicted the learning context negatively, stating they just sit down and do paperwork
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt they would just learn for the test and then forget about it, viewing the tasks as lacking skills developed along the way
related_quotes: sit down and just do paperwork
learn this for your test and then forget about it.

behavior_patterns.condition: When placed in traditional school settings without hands-on learning
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Expresses that school is just a place to sit down and do paperwork
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Views the curriculum as irrelevant long-term, believing they will forget it after the test
